name: indrop
description: inDrop data; exact barcode geometry can be dataset-specific.

halt_guidance.blocker: inDrop barcode structure and whitelist depend on chemistry generation and library implementation; the version cannot be selected safely from a platform name alone.
required_inputs: inDrop chemistry/version and matching barcode whitelist
Confirmed barcode segments, UMI coordinates, cDNA read, and linker handling
next_steps: Identify the inDrop chemistry generation from methods and supplementary files.
Obtain the matching whitelist and verify all barcode/linker coordinates against FASTQ content.
Run zUMIs or a chemistry-matched parser, then validate barcode recovery and cell counts before using the matrix.

recommended_workflows.name: zUMIs
recommended_workflows.role: Configurable barcode/UMI parsing when the exact inDrop geometry is known

halt_guidance.resume: An explicit STARsolo route is appropriate only after the chemistry-specific whitelist and barcode segments have been validated.
